items.en: The file preview is larger, with the file's contents on the left, a search for this file, page and zoom controls, and a recognized-text view for PDFs.
items.zh: 文件预览更大了：左侧显示文件目录，可在当前文件中搜索，支持翻页与缩放，PDF 还可切换查看识别出的文字。

items.en: The LMS line on the course info card now fits on one line, and the card size switcher no longer has a squared-off edge.
items.zh: 课程信息卡片中的 LMS 一行现在只占一行，卡片尺寸切换条也不再有被裁成直角的边缘。

items.en: Grade forecasts are steadier when a category has only a few scores so far.
items.zh: 成绩预测在分类里分数较少时更稳定。

items.en: Headings and search snippets from PDFs no longer show Markdown symbols such as asterisks.
items.zh: PDF 的标题和搜索摘要不再显示星号等 Markdown 符号。

items.en: Long assignment names in the Canvas tab now stay on one line next to their icon instead of pushing it onto its own line.
items.zh: Canvas 页签中过长的作业名称现在与图标保持在同一行，不再把图标挤到单独一行。
